description: Durable, idempotent workflow execution engine. Executes what the Control Plane has already authorized. Completely policy-deaf — never evaluates or decides policy. Provides retry semantics, DLQ, cancellation, and execution telemetry.
nonNegotiableRules: Never evaluate policy — call Control Plane for authorization
All /execute submissions must carry authorizationDecisionId (unless dryRun)
Idempotency key deduplication must prevent double-execution
All execution events must be emitted via the platform event bus
Retry only transient and timeout failures — never policy_denied or auth_failure
Dead-letter permanently failed runs — never silently drop
